messages:
zoe_marketing: Need a small, defensible bench packet for the launch blog + webinar. Focus: warmup (cold starts) vs steady-state. Can runtime produce a tight deliverable?

zoe_marketing: Wanted outputs: 1) 20 prompts (short/med/long) 2) three variants per model (fp16, q8, q4 if available) 3) cold first-token distribution (~500 runs short/med, 250 long) 4) steady-state p50/p95 token latencies at conc=1 and conc=4 5) 6 sample output pairs (fp16 vs quant) + 1-line notes 6) a one-paragraph methodology blurb and a tiny curl repro snippet

kyle_runtime: We can do that. Quick clarifications: q4 may not exist for the medium model; we'll report fallback. Also prefer billing-token accounting for the cost chart?

zoe_marketing: Use billing tokens. Keep artifacts reproducible: include runtime build tag, instance type, quant label.

anya_sre: Add kernel sha and whether oss/custom kernels used. Also include trace ids for the 6 samples.

devon_runtime: I'll run a smoke tonight (small sample) and then full runs Mon. If scheduler pressure, we'll default to the MVP: short+med cold heatmaps + steady-state conc=1 + 4 sample pairs.

kyle_runtime: Repro snippet we'll put in artifacts. We'll simulate coldstart with fresh worker per run. Confirm?

zoe_marketing: Yes, fresh worker per run. Please flag any quality regressions in quant variants with short annotations. Deadline: EOD Tue ideally; if not possible, tell us MVP ETA.

kyle_runtime: Understood. Smoke ETA ~2h, full artifacts likely Tue morning. We'll post link to marketing bucket and @mention you in the drop.
